dati.s: Asset shooting · 2 days · 2 talent · Standard rates
dati.sc: Two consecutive shooting days producing the complete asset package for the VVENA 2026 campaign. Photography and film are captured in parallel with two talent, covering the main campaign film, three vertical social contents and a library of approximately fifty retouched still images. Standard rates for a production of this scope: crew, equipment and post production are each priced at market value, with no items absorbed. Reference baseline for Quotation 1 and Quotation 2.

i.d: Canon EOS R5 + RF lens set

inc: Full camera, lens and lighting package
Editing and retouch of @50 selected images
Color correction on film and social contents
Make-up, hair and styling for both shooting days

ur.t: magazines and printed editorial or promotional media

dati.urn: TV advertising, billboards, OOH and sponsored social media are not included and will be quoted separately.
dati.pg: Bank transfer, 60 days end of month.
dati.wd: Documented expenses and lost profit, set at 60% of the agreed fee.
